git commit -am "Add weekly subscription support

- \`subtrack add \"Meal kit\" 59.90 --every week\` now works
- Weekly plans cost price × 52 ÷ 12 per month (rounded to nearest cent)
  - Example: €12/week = €52.00/month
- Weekly plans charge every 7 days from --since date
- \`subtrack renewals\` lists all upcoming weekly charges within the window,
  sorted chronologically alongside monthly and yearly plans
- Fixed renewal sorting to use date order instead of lexicographic labels

step_results:
Perfect! I've successfully implemented weekly subscription support for subtrack. Here's a summary of what was added:

## Changes Made

**src/cycles.js:**
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK: 'weekly'` constant
- Updated `monthlyCents()` to calculate weekly cost as: `price × 52 ÷ 12`, rounded to nearest cent
- Updated `nextCharge()` to calculate weekly charges every 7 days from the first charge date

**bin/subtrack.js:**
- Added 'week' and 'weekly' as valid `--every` options
- Updated SHARE_PER_MONTH to handle weekly (52/12 ratio)
- Updated usage and error messages

**src/renewals.js:**
- Fixed sorting to use chronological order (`inDays`) instead of lexicographic order (`when` labels)
- Modified to show all upcoming weekly charges within the window (not just the first one)

**Tests:**
- Added 4 new tests verifying weekly subscription functionality
- All 38 tests pass

## Feature Demo

```bash
$ subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week --since 2026-10-13
Added Meal kit: €59.90 weekly, €259.57 a month.

$ subtrack list
Meal kit      €59.90 weekly      €259.57 a month

$ subtrack renewals --within 30 --today 2026-10-20
20 Oct  Meal kit  €59.90
27 Oct  Meal kit  €59.90
3 Nov   Meal kit  €59.90
10 Nov  Meal kit  €59.90
17 Nov  Meal kit  €59.90
```

Weekly plans integrate fully with all existing commands (list, total, renewals, export) and follow the same patterns as monthly and yearly subscriptions.
